description: Start here. Call Recta before your agent moves stablecoins from one blockchain to another (a bridge or cross-chain transfer): give it the route you would use anyway, and it answers, for free, whether a cheaper route exists at the same chain state and proves the saving. If there is none, nothing is charged. Transfers start on: arbitrum, arc, avalanche, base, bnb_chain, ethereum, hyperevm, ink, linea, monad, optimism, polygon, unichain. They can arrive on: arbitrum, arc, avalanche, base, bnb_chain, ethereum, hyperevm, ink, linea, monad, optimism, polygon, robinhood_chain, solana_mainnet, tron_mainnet, unichain. Assets: USDC, USDC_BINANCE_PEG, USDG, USDT, USDT_BINANCE_PEG, USDT_OP_BRIDGED. Amounts: at least 3.5 tokens of a stablecoin (about 3.5 USD), no maximum. The exact corridors are in the service descriptor. Returns the full guide (llms.txt): what Recta is, the fee (5 % of the verified saving, nothing if none) and the call flow.
name: recta_about
title: What Recta is and how it charges
